item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 07/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coastal areas of Guangdong tomorrow. An anticyclone aloft is expected to affect Guangdong on Friday, the weather will improve over the region. With the anticyclone aloft weakening, there will be sunny intervals and a few showers on the Mid-Autumn Festival and the following couple of days over the coast of Guangdong. A relatively dry continental airstream will bring fine and very hot weather to southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, the tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific will move across the seas east of the Philippines in the next couple of days.
